summary: Independent review reproduced the original breakable DSA decode failure on the prepared base: the checked-out Indexer.forward_cuda path discarded valid backend metadata and passed None to get_page_table_64. At the exact candidate commit, the regression passes because breakable mode resolves backend metadata while TC-piecewise retains its custom-op handoff. Related DSA page-table tests also pass against independent PyTorch references. The change is Python-only and does not require a native rebuild.

tests.what_was_measured: On base 358c163, valid backend metadata was replaced by None and the paged decode path raised AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'get_page_table_64'. Raw output: /job/review-evidence/j-85c552a3f649/logs/base_reproduction.log

At candidate a0f2522, both GPU regressions passed: valid DSA metadata reached get_page_table_64, and a backend intentionally returning no DSA metadata remained a clean no-op. Result: 2 passed. Raw output: /job/review-evidence/j-85c552a3f649/logs/candidate_regression.log

10 tests and 4 subtests passed on the assigned gfx950 GPU. The suite checks decode/prefill page-table transformations and metadata interfaces against independent PyTorch references, including mixed lengths, padding, empty batches, large contexts, and nontrivial strides. Raw output: /job/review-evidence/j-85c552a3f649/logs/related_dsa_gpu.log
Confirmed the reviewed candidate is directly based on the prepared base commit.

gpu_evidence: PyTorch reported AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, and all focused/related tests executed with real device='cuda' ROCm tensors on the assigned GPU.
remaining_limitations: The full zai-org/GLM-5.3 launch could not be run: the report requires a 753B FP8 model with TP4/PP2 across eight MI300X GPUs, while this job provides one MI350X and no model weights.
The source environment used gfx942/MI300X and Torch 2.9.1+ROCm 7.2; this prepared environment uses gfx950/MI350X and Torch 2.11.0+ROCm 7.2.

The full server startup-to-serving condition therefore remains unverified, although the exact failing implementation path and its page-table contract were exercised before and after on real ROCm tensors.

No FlyDSL C++ or other native source changed in the candidate, so a native rebuild was not applicable. Source imports resolved from /job/repo/python/sglang, while aiter loaded /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-85c552a3f649/cache/aiter/module_aiter_core.so.
